package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_serialization_json_decoder_without_reuse_for_stream: Layer: Serialization and deserialization. Flag JSON decoders created for each element of a stream instead of decoding the stream once.
// fixture polarity: negative; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type Rule591NegativeRecord struct { Name string `json:"name"`; Count int `json:"count"` }

func scenario591Negative(stream io.Reader) (int, error) {
	dec := json.NewDecoder(stream)
	total := 0
	for {
		var rec Rule591NegativeRecord
		if err := dec.Decode(&rec); err != nil {
			if err == io.EOF { return total, nil }
			return 0, err
		}
		total += rec.Count
	}
}
